physicalNotes: Radius 1.543 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Heidari et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 88986 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...681A..55H/abstract): 1,073,465 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
